ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: A ruler and a right-angled triangle ruler containing a $30^\circ$ angle are placed as shown in the figure. If $\angle 1 = 22^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle 2$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, draw line CE through point C such that CE$\parallel$AB, \\
$\because$AB$\parallel$GH, $\therefore$AB$\parallel$GH$\parallel$CE, $\therefore$$\angle$1=$\angle$DCE=$22^\circ$, $\angle$2=$\angle$ECF, $\therefore$$\angle$2=$\angle$ECF=$\angle$DCF−$\angle$DCE=$60^\circ−22^\circ=\boxed{38^\circ}$.
